resolved_owners.resolution: The helper returns a new cold native List value without Memory/Surface/GPU ownership. It intentionally does not intern filenames or lists; callers allocate once per distinct imported list identity and all aliases borrow that owner. Independent names remain owned after the declaration is destroyed. RegularResources fixed identity owns lists/groups/catalog/localizations; menu aliases borrow those list objects; font owns its separate list. No list resizing/moving after bindings are published.

semantic_review.semantic_justification: entries are optional group indices; bindings carry optional archive strings/list indices. These represent real absent group/archive/list pointers, not fixture availability. Importer interns equal original list/group pointers into indices and records VA reconstruction separately. bind_texture_list checks both parallel vector sizes before construction, value-initializes exactly count null Memory* entries, copies every attribute, allocates immutable owned string per present filename and preserves null filename as nullptr. first_filename_invalid remains false; sentinel and preloaded texture metadata are rejected by importer, not silently supported.
